close_reason: Fixed: added issuer.subject == delta_crl.issuer check (mirror of step 2b) before delta sig verify in crl.rs
description: File: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs ~line 265. The delta CRL signature is verified using issuer.subject_public_key_info (line 272), but there is no check that issuer.tbs_certificate.subject == delta_crl.tbs_cert_list.issuer. The base CRL path got step (2b) in commit e7919455, but the delta path was missed. Add the same check before the delta sig verify.
title: P1: delta CRL path missing issuer.subject == delta_crl.issuer check before sig verify
